g.text: RobotKinematics component (components/RobotKinematics, Eigen + optional Coal mesh collision)
edits it (FK via ForwardKinematics::toolPose, IK via
outgoing pick on the send path, and when collision is
enabled also runs Coal mesh self-collision on each
180 + rx, ry, rz). It was (x,y,z,180,0,r), which
hard-coded top-down and silently dropped the incoming
rx / ry -- a gap Phase 5 itself opened by adding them
to the wire format. Folding the 180 flip into the roll
term is EXACT, not an approximation: rotations about a
shared axis commute, so Rx(rx)*Rx(180) == Rx(180+rx).
At rx = ry = 0 it reduces to the old form.
